title: Uncomplicated
text: Uncomplicated. We love our miniature single cup coffee maker.  Uncomplicated, simple, easy to use and clean.

product_metadata.title: Mixpresso Single Cup Coffee Maker | Personal, Single Serve Coffee Brewer Machine, Compatible with Single-Cups | Quick Brew Technology, Programmable Features, One Touch Function (Black)
features: INSTANT COFFEE MAKER: Our Single Serve Coffee maker is exactly what you need to start your day productively and on a high note! Compatible with K-Cups and easily programmable, our coffee machine can instantly brew your favorite brand of ground coffee with our quick-brewing technology!

100% AUTOMATIC FUNCTION: Make your favorite flavors of Single Cup pods or ground coffee instantly since the preheating time is just 2 minutes. Just press one button to start and shut down, and press and hold the button to drain the water and effortlessly clean the inner part of the coffee maker as well!

PREMIUM CONSTRUCTION FOR COFFEE LOVERS: With 800 Watts of power and heavy-duty materials, this Single Cup Coffee Maker is perfect for anyone living alone or even for families whose sleeping schedule does not coincide. Program your new electric coffee maker to prepare a 4, 6, 8, 10, or 12 oz cup of coffee and wake up with pure energy and delicious taste!

A BREEZE TO CLEAN: We know you’re probably a busy man or woman with not much time to replace coffee filters or clean messy kitchen accidents! Now, you can wash the single cup serve pods drawer under the tap and quickly fill the small coffee maker under the tap! Literally takes a few seconds to clean and reuse.

LOVE IT OR YOUR MONEY BACK: Here at Mixpresso, your satisfaction is the core of our mission. That’s why we want you to get in touch with us if you are not entirely thrilled with your purchase for ANY reason, and we will make it right. After all, your Mixpresso Coffee Makers is covered under the umbrella of our 1-YEAR WARRANTY.
